6.7.424

What's Changed

  • ci: Bump the .NET SDK to 10.0.114 (backport #26074) by @mergify[bot] in #26079

  • fix: Release subscriptions of never-loaded repeaters and collected bindings (backport #26115) by @mergify[bot] in #26192
  • fix: Don't let the DP storage pools keep arrays of collected objects (6.7) by @Xiaoy312 in #26252
  • fix(databinding): reject bindable metadata resolved across ALC boundaries (backport #24096) by @agneszitte in #26272
  • fix(flyout): Keep flyouts above the on-screen keyboard (backport #26060) (backport #26062) by @mergify[bot] in #26267

  • fix(binding): Remove stale callbacks and follow indexed collections (backport #26219) by @mergify[bot] in #26256
  • fix(win32): Move XAML focus to the WebView2 when the browser takes focus (backport #26263) by @mergify[bot] in #26269
